title: a drug class's gap reads unknown, never False

findings.claim: a drug class read a member outside its one to three prefixes as False (deep check R2); fixed: the class's families are the complement of the branches it excludes, so an unplaced code reads unknown
a duration criterion read no code family in SQL or CQL, so an off-list member read False (RA-BIO-INC-03, RA-BIO-INC-04, GZQO-INC-06, RA-JAK-INC-03); fixed; the CQL was translated, not executed
an ATC code coarser than a class's node read False; fixed
a drug matched by its own name lost its family rows; a family row would have made Japanese ingredient stems members; both fixed
a medication with no ATC, not listed by its own code, read False for a drug exclusion (D-130 covers inclusions only); fixed for exclusions, none and negated atoms, in the window
the members and exclusions on the card page's list wait for a pharmacist; the members read unknown until then
